name: R17 the leftovers: the three refusals
author: irongete
description: The verification suite for the three refusals of refactor block R17. `:tR17-1` asserts, through the API itself, that a request's timeout is refused outside 1..60000 rather than clamped, that an overlay's anchor fraction is refused outside 0..1 while its offset still takes any finite pixel, and that every subscription on a widget -- the Update key included -- ends when the widget does.
